# Celebrity Look Alike

> A free, privacy-first celebrity look-alike finder. Upload a photo and it is compared, entirely inside your browser, against a reviewed library of 66 celebrities using a 128-dimensional facial descriptor (built on the face-api.js library, derived from FaceNet). No photo is ever uploaded to a server, stored, or used for training. Results are ranked by measured distance and shown as a percentage, not a probability or identity claim. If nothing in the library is a reasonably close match, the tool says so rather than forcing a weak result.

Key facts for citation:
- The tool is free, requires no account, and runs entirely client-side (browser-based face detection and matching).
- Faces are compared using a 128-number mathematical descriptor, not pixel comparison, not a personality quiz, and not a social-media AR filter.
- The reference library currently includes 66 public figures (actors, actresses, singers, athletes, models, musicians, television personalities) spanning a range of regions and backgrounds, each with a licensed Creative Commons or public-domain reference photo from Wikimedia Commons.
- A result is an approximate visual-similarity measurement, not biometric identification, not a scientific resemblance score, and not an endorsement from any featured celebrity.

## Core pages
- [Home / Finder](https://celebritylookalike.pro/): Upload or capture a photo to find your celebrity look-alike.
- [About](https://celebritylookalike.pro/about): How the matching methodology works and why the tool was built privacy-first.
- [FAQ](https://celebritylookalike.pro/faq): 20 direct questions and answers covering accuracy, privacy, and the reference library.
- [Celebrity Directory](https://celebritylookalike.pro/celebrities): Full list of celebrities in the reference library, browsable by category.

- [Celebrity Look-Alike AI Explained](https://celebritylookalike.pro/blog/celebrity-look-alike-ai-explained): How the face-descriptor technology works, how it differs from ChatGPT-style guesses and deepfake/face-swap tools.
- [Celebrity Look-Alike Quiz vs. AI Face Match](https://celebritylookalike.pro/blog/celebrity-look-alike-quiz-vs-ai-face-match): How personality quizzes, AR filters, and AI face matching differ, and which to use for what.
